description_en: Retrieves the page view (PV) statistics of an accelerated domain name on an hourly basis. Data collected within the last 90 days can be queried
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainPvData按小时粒度获取加速域名的PV页面访问统计，支持获取最近90天的数据
name: DescribeDomainPvData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify only one domain name
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，仅支持查询一个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the data to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the data to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between the returned entries. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，单位为秒

EndTime.description_en: The end time. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard
EndTime.description_zh: 结束时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

StartTime.description_en: The start time. The time is in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard
StartTime.description_zh: 开始时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间
